_comment: Actor types: reusable bundles of defaults an actor inherits with "type": "<key>". An actor's own keys always win over its type's. attributes, stats and collision_effect merge one level deep; every other key replaces wholesale. Types do not inherit from other types. The optional "domain" field marks what a type is for — only "actor" is resolved today; "item" is reserved so items can share this file later.

beast.name: beast
beast.description: Animals and vermin. A mind, but no hands and no possessions. Hunts or is hostile.

undead.name: undead
undead.description: The animate dead in various states of decay.

terrain.name: terrain
terrain.description: Built and grown scenery — walls, columns, statues. Mindless, so it can burn or be stuck but never confused or put to sleep.
